Name: More Authentic Farming
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]Now players can unlock a recipe at Farming Level 2 to combine explosive pellets with manure, creating a manure bomb that can be launched via slingshot, inflicting massive psychological damage on monsters and NPCs.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Core Concept: Connecting Livestock and Agriculture
In vanilla Stardew Valley, livestock and farming operate rather independently. This mod breaks down that barrier, letting the two complement and benefit each other. Animals are no longer just resource nodes—they become the engine driving your agricultural productivity.[/color]

New: Feces Ammo & NPC Fear Reactions

All animal feces (including rare Golden Feces) can now be loaded into the slingshot!

Regular Feces: deals 50 damage

Golden Feces: deals a devastating 8888 damage (like a nuke!)

Hitting an NPC with feces triggers a fear reaction:

The NPC will jump, shake, and show a shocked expression

Random angry/shocked speech bubbles appear above their head

The NPC loses 30 friendship points

Reaction dialogues support both English and Chinese

Add a little "prank" fun to your farm life!

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🐄 Animal Feces System
Your farm animals now produce [b]realistic feces[/b]![/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Trigger[/b]: 25% daily chance per animal[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Unique Appearances[/b]: Different animals produce different feces visuals[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Chicken, Duck → Poultry Feces[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Cow → Cow Feces[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pig → Pig Feces[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sheep, Rabbit, Goat, Ostrich, Camel → Pellet Feces[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dinosaurs or mod animals → Default Feces[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Golden Feces[/b]: Extremely rare (0.1% chance)—highly valuable![/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]This means[/b]: You'll need to check your barn floors daily, collect feces, and turn waste into a valuable agricultural resource.[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]⚙️ Feces Processing & Animal Fertilizer
Feces is no longer waste—it's a precious agricultural resource![/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fertilizer Processor[/b]: 1 feces → 1 Animal Fertilizer (60 minutes processing time)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Animal Fertilizer[/b]: Crops have a [b]10% chance to yield an extra produce[/b] when harvested[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Same Quality[/b]: Bonus crops match the original crop's quality[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]This means[/b]: Every extra pile of feces your animals produce could mean an extra crop from your fields. Livestock directly fuels agricultural productivity.[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🌽 Corn Feed System
Corn feed is another vital link between farming and livestock.[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Corn Processor[/b]: 1 Corn → 1 Corn Feed (30 minutes processing time)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Feeding Mechanism[/b]: Feed can be placed directly into troughs; animals will consume it automatically[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Silo Storage[/b]: Store feed in silos alongside hay—they share capacity but don't interfere[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Auto-Feeding[/b]: Barn upgrades will use hay first, then automatically switch to corn feed when hay is low[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Easy Access[/b]: Right-click a silo to view hay and corn feed counts; right-click the feed hopper to retrieve either[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]This means[/b]: Your corn crops now have a vital new purpose beyond selling or brewing—they become feed. Agriculture feeds livestock, while livestock fertilizes agriculture.[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🤖 Auto Collector
To help you manage large-scale animal operations, the Auto Collector automates feces collection.[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Placement[/b]: Must be placed inside barns or coops[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Auto-Collect[/b]: Gathers all feces within the building daily and stores them internally[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]One-Click Retrieval[/b]: Right-click the collector to view and retrieve stored items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stress-Free Management[/b]: No more daily manual collecting![/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]This means[/b]: You can focus on big-picture farm planning without being bogged down by tedious daily chores.[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]The Complete Ecosystem Cycle
text
  Corn Farming (Agriculture)
      ↓
  Corn Processing → Corn Feed
      ↓
  Animal Consumption → Feces Production
      ↓
  Feces Processing → Animal Fertilizer
      ↓
  Fertilizer Application → Bonus Crop Yield
      ↓
  More Corn → More Feed → More Feces → More Fertilizer → More Yield[/color]
现在玩家可以在耕种等级二解锁配方，选择爆炸弹丸与粪便合成，粪便炸弹可通过弹弓射出去，对怪物和 NPC 造成巨大的心理伤害
[color=#D4D4D8]核心理念：畜牧业与农业的紧密联动
在星露谷物语原版中，畜牧业和农业相对独立。本模组打破了这种隔阂，让两者相互促进、彼此受益。动物不仅仅是产出产品的资源点，更成为农业生产的重要推动力。[/color]
[b]新增内容：粪便弹弓弹药 & NPC惊恐反应[/b]
[list]
[*]所有动物粪便（包括稀有的黄金粪便）现在都可以装入弹弓发射！
[list]
[*]普通粪便：造成 [b]50 点[/b] 伤害[/*]
[*]黄金粪便：造成 [b]8888 点[/b] 恐怖伤害（堪比核弹！）[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]用粪便砸中 NPC 会触发惊恐反应：
[list]
[*]NPC 会跳起、颤抖，露出惊讶的表情[/*]
[*]头顶随机弹出愤怒/惊恐的对话气泡（如“呕！！！”、“我靠，谁这么缺德！”等）[/*]
[*]该 NPC 会损失 30 点好感度[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]反应对话支持中英双语，生动有趣[/*]
[/list][b]让牧场生活多一份“恶作剧”的乐趣！[/b]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🐄 动物粪便系统
你的农场动物现在会产生[b]真实的粪便[/b]！[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]触发机制[/b]：每天有 25% 的概率产生粪便[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]多样外观[/b]：不同动物产生不同的粪便外观[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]鸡、鸭 → 家禽粪便[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]牛 → 牛粪[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]猪 → 猪粪[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]羊、兔、山羊、鸵鸟、骆驼 → 丸状粪便[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]恐龙或其他模组动物 → 默认粪便[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]黄金粪便[/b]：0.1% 的稀有概率产出黄金粪便，价值连城[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]这意味着[/b]：你每天都需要关注畜棚的地面，收集粪便，保持环境清洁，同时获取宝贵的农业资源。[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]⚙️ 粪便加工与动物肥料
粪便不再是垃圾，而是宝贵的农业资源！[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]粪便加工器[/b]：将 1 份粪便加工成 1 份动物肥料（加工时间 60 分钟）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]动物肥料[/b]：施肥后，作物在收获时有 [b]10% 的概率额外产出一份作物[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]品质一致[/b]：额外产出的作物品质与原作物完全相同[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]这意味着[/b]：你的动物每多产一份粪便，你的田地就可能多收获一份作物。畜牧业直接为农业生产提供动力。[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🌽 玉米饲料系统
玉米饲料是连接农业与畜牧业的另一条纽带。[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]玉米加工机[/b]：将 1 根玉米加工成 1 份玉米饲料（加工时间 30 分钟）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]喂食机制[/b]：饲料可以直接放入畜棚食槽，动物会自动食用[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]筒仓存储[/b]：支持将饲料存入筒仓，与干草共用存储空间，互不影响[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自动喂食[/b]：畜棚升级后，系统会优先使用干草，干草不足时自动使用玉米饲料[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]取用方便[/b]：右键筒仓查看干草与饲料数量，右键喂食口可取出干草或饲料[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]这意味着[/b]：你的玉米除了直接出售或酿酒，现在多了一个重要的用途——转化为饲料。农业为畜牧业提供稳定的食物来源，畜牧业则为农业提供优质的肥料。[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🤖 粪便自动收集器
为方便玩家管理大规模的动物饲养，我们提供了自动收集器。[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]放置位置[/b]：必须放置在畜棚或鸡舍内部[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自动收集[/b]：每天自动收集建筑内所有粪便，存入内部存储[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]右键取用[/b]：右键点击收集器，可以查看并拿取其中存储的所有粪便[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]便捷管理[/b]：告别每天手动捡拾粪便的繁琐操作[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]这意味着[/b]：你可以更专注于农场的整体规划，而不必被日常琐事困扰。[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]完整的生态循环
text
  玉米种植（农业）
      ↓
  玉米加工 → 玉米饲料
      ↓
  动物进食 → 动物产生粪便
      ↓
  粪便加工 → 动物肥料
      ↓
  肥料施肥 → 作物额外产出
      ↓
  更多玉米 → 更多饲料 → 更多粪便 → 更多肥料 → 更多产出[/color]
